description.p: Lucerna plays video and animated-image wallpapers as your desktop background. A small background service keeps them running after the control window is closed, restores them when you log in, and pauses them while they are covered by a fullscreen window or the screen is locked.

ul.li: Use any video or animated image that mpv can play, without copying it anywhere
One wallpaper for every monitor, or a different one on each
Fill, fit, stretch and center scaling
Silent by default, with hardware decoding and an FPS limit
A command-line controller and diagnostics for scripting and bug reports

description.p: Lucerna currently supports X11 sessions, with Linux Mint Cinnamon as the target desktop.
